capabilities: Display cover art above the note title in Reading view and Live Preview
Cache covers locally under _discogs-covers/ for offline reuse
Prefill the cache for all notes with a discogs property via a command
Reference cached covers from Bases image columns
extras: Not yet on the community plugin list; manual installation from release files is required.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to show album cover art for music release notes from a Discogs release ID.

relations.evidence: The image is fetched once from the Discogs API

summary: Cover-art plugin that displays a note's Discogs release cover above the title and caches images locally for reuse in Bases.
